column1: # Windows batch counters (.bat, .cmd), for a rule with the prompt file-body-fallback: one per line,
# label TAB pattern (Java regex), keywords in any case as cmd.exe reads them. The [ignore] line
# blanks REM and :: comment lines, a REM after an & (echo x & rem note) and the text an echo prints
# (echo, echo. and echo: up to the line end or an &, |, < or >), so a "goto" in a comment or an "if"
# or "call" in a message does not count. "labels" counts a :name
# at the start of a line (a call or goto target); "variables set" every set, set /a and set /p, also
# after an if or in a for body; "conditionals (approx)" every if; "for loops" a for over a %variable,
# with its options or the root of a /r; "exits" an exit command, not a label :exit nor a goto to it;
# "error level checks" every errorlevel as a word (%ERRORLEVEL% too), not a label that ends in it
# ProfileFactPatternsLinearityTest measures that every pattern reads linearly.
[ignore] REM and :: comment lines, echoed text
